scope: Read-only inventory of all actually exposed selections in current local Linxu site, including accessible Before variants. No visual acceptance claim.

non_exposed_comparison_notes.reason: The v2 retarget script removed Run_Before. The app guard requires the clip to exist, so none+Run has no comparison toggle.

scene_notes: createMotionContext() adds a stool for both seated actions and a ledge for HangToCrouch; these are runtime props, not part of character GLB.
Browser textures/materials must be preserved for actual-surface rendering. Generic read() removes materials; reload originals or export posed original GLB.
Character source is V4 neck-proportioned GLB (ratio 0.82), not the untouched uploaded character.

rows.animation_mixer_loop: LoopOnce with clampWhenFinished; evaluated by absolute-time pose()

qa_only_walk_floor_smoothing.source_preserved: All source rotations, duration, Hips.x/z and source Hips.y piecewise-linear bob unchanged. Only additive floor-correction smoothed.
